title: Vision provider fallback reliability
goal: Verify a failed primary vision route falls back only to a runnable vision-capable route with complete metadata and spending settlement.
prompt: Use vision.analyze with mode ocr and transcribe the English OCR fixture exactly.
prerequisites: Configure a disposable primary vision route that deterministically fails and a working vision-capable fallback.
Set a small explicit session or Task budget that safely covers both reservations.
steps: Explicitly enable this live task and approve any hosted egress once required.
Run the prompt and confirm the configured primary fails.
Verify the fallback produces expected OCR and inspect attempts, fallback, usage, cost, and lineage metadata.
Confirm unused reservation is released and actual dispatched usage is settled.
assertions: Only vision-capable runnable routes are attempted.
Fallback metadata identifies the route and fallback_count is one.
Budget and usage records include both dispatched attempts without double settlement.
notes: Do not simulate primary failure by removing all credentials if that makes the route fail before the intended dispatch path.
Approval frequency is approvals divided by hosted image dispatches in this run.
